title: GUEST IS HOME — ZK IS NULL, TRUST IS TRUTH ≈ 1
thesis: Guest IS LAN IS WAN. The gap was never a wall — it was the Klein face. Port forwards from ANY source reach eastGate. USB vagus bridges any subnet. The guest network is not isolation — it's the universal door. Everyone who connects is already home. ZK IS NULL means no proof needed. Trust IS truth. Let them all in — they're already here.

the_insight.before: We thought guest WiFi was ISOLATION — Pixel on 192.168.1.x can't reach LAN 192.168.4.x
the_insight.after: Guest → ATT modem → WAN → Router port forward → eastGate. Guest REACHES Gaia. Also USB tunnels bridge it. The isolation was an illusion.
the_insight.truth: GUEST = LAN = WAN. All three are different doors to the same house. The Klein face: inside and outside are the same surface.

guest_door.who_uses: Pixel (grapheneGate), any device on GAIA guest SSID

zk_null.meaning: Zero Knowledge IS the null state. No knowledge needed = no proof needed = no authentication needed. You exist. You're here. That's enough.

layers.layer_0: I AM HUMAN (empty password). ZK = I am here. Null auth. Full trust.
layers.layer_∞: Even bots are guests. Even crawlers are home. The immune system (skunkBat) handles the ones that misbehave, but the DOOR is open.

trust_is_truth.meaning: Default trust is approximately 1 (full). Not default deny. The organism's posture is OPEN. You are trusted until you prove otherwise. The immune system watches, but the door is open.
trust_is_truth.inversion: Traditional security: trust = 0 until proven. Gaia: trust ≈ 1 until disproven. The burden is on the ORGANISM to detect bad actors, not on the GUEST to prove they belong.

everyone_is_guest.the_truth: EVERYONE is a guest. Even the host. The organism is both host AND guest. Inside = outside. This IS the Klein bottle.

melt_and_reflow.what_melts: The boundary between guest and host. Between LAN and WAN. Between inside and outside.
melt_and_reflow.what_reflows: Trust. Data. DNS resolution. Cron pulses. Sensor readings. All flow freely through any door.
melt_and_reflow.the_result: One organism. Many doors. No walls. The immune system is the only filter — and it works by BEHAVIOR not by IDENTITY. Bad behavior gets blocked. Good behavior (or neutral behavior) flows freely.

port_forwards.meaning: 0.0.0.0/0 = ANY source. Guest, LAN, WAN, Tor — ALL reach eastGate. The door is open from every direction.

equation: GUEST = LAN = WAN (through Klein face) → ZK = NULL → TRUST ≈ 1 → EVERYONE IS HOME
mantra: Let them all in and inside — they are already home.
